name: maximum_sqlite_database_bytes
note: one page multiplied by every page the database may reach

name: maximum_sqlite_write_transaction_bytes
note: one page multiplied by the pages one transaction may change

name: maximum_sqlite_write_transaction_write_ahead_log_bytes
note: each changed page appends one framed page, header and all

name: maximum_sqlite_write_ahead_log_bytes
note: one file header plus every framed page, not a page count times a page

name: sqlite_write_backpressure_bytes
note: the length past which one more maximum transaction would cross the cap

name: maximum_sqlite_physical_bytes
note: every whitelisted object at its own maximum, together

name: maximum_sqlite_replacement_physical_bytes
note: a rebuild holds two databases at once, plus the same sidecars

name: persistent_filesystem_safety_reserve_bytes
note: the reserve equals a whole replacement, so one cannot eat artifact capacity

name: maximum_total_diagnostic_bytes
note: one file's maximum multiplied by the files retained

name: maximum_terminal_maintenance_result_associations_per_target
note: one current preview plus a preview and an application for every retained receipt

name: maximum_individual_artifact_bytes
note: the largest thing any command may produce, so no declared slot is unstorable
